prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: The Company’s provision for credit losses during the third quarter of 2026 amounted to $12.6 million , compared with $22.6 million in the third quarter of 2025. The provision for credit losses for the third quarter of 2026 was comprised of a provision of $13.3 million related to loans, negative $727,000 related to unfunded commitments and negative $1,000 related to other credit losses, respectively, compared with $11.2 million related to loans, $11.4 million related to unfunded commitments and $8,000 related to other credit losses for the third quarter of 2025. The increase in the provision for credit losses on loans is primarily attributable to the updated economic forecast, an increase in net charge-offs and organic loan growth. The decrease in the provision for unfunded commitments primarily resulted from relatively stable levels of unfunded commitments in the third quarter of 2026 , compared with increases in unfunded commitments and expected funding rates during the third quarter of 2025 . Non-performing assets as a percentage of total assets increased ten basis points to 0.54% at September 30, 2026, compared with 0.44% at December 31, 2025.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonint.text: Total noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 increased $4.2 million, or 2.7%, to $158.7 million, compared with $154.6 million in the same quarter 2025. Salaries and employee benefits decreased $618,000, or 0.7%, from $90.9 million in the third quarter of 2025 to $90.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, due primarily to a decrease in mortgage commissions. D ata processing and communication expenses increased $1.0 million, or 6.5%, to $17.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $16.1 million in the third quarter of 2025 , with the increase primarily resulting from an increase in volume and continued technology investment. Advertising and marketing expense was $3.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $3.4 million in the third quarter of 2025 . Amortization of intangible assets decreased $935,000 , or 24.1% , from $3.9 million in the third quarter of 2025 to $2.9 million in the third quarter of 2026. This decrease was primarily related to a reduction in core deposit and customer relationship intangible amortization.

nonop.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonop.text: Total noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 increased $4.2 million, or 2.7%, to $158.7 million, compared with $154.6 million in the same quarter 2025. Salaries and employee benefits decreased $618,000, or 0.7%, from $90.9 million in the third quarter of 2025 to $90.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, due primarily to a decrease in mortgage commissions. Advertising and marketing expense was $3.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $3.4 million in the third quarter of 2025 . Amortization of intangible assets decreased $935,000 , or 24.1% , from $3.9 million in the third quarter of 2025 to $2.9 million in the third quarter of 2026. tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: Income tax expense is influenced by the statutory rate, the amount of taxable income, the amount of tax-exempt income and the amount of nondeductible expenses. For the third quarter of 2026, the Company reported income tax expense of $34.4 million , compared with $31.0 million in the same period of 2025. The Company’s effective tax rate for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was 22.9% and 22.6%, respectively. The increase in the effective rate for the three months ended September 30, 2026 is primarily related to an increase in pre-tax income and nondeductible compensation expenses.

net.text: Ameris reported net income available to common shareholders of $116.1 million, or $1.73 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared with $106.0 million, or $1.54 per diluted share, for the same period in 2025. The Company’s return on average assets and average shareholders’ equity were 1.61% and 11.15%, respectively, in the third quarter of 2026, compared with 1.56% and 10.61%, respectively, in the third quarter of 2025.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income and Margin
Net interest income.text:
The following table sets forth the average balance, interest income or interest expense, and average interest rate for each category of interest-earning assets and interest-bearing liabilities, net interest spread, and net interest margin on average interest-earning assets for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025. Federally tax-exempt income is presented on a taxable-equivalent basis assuming a 21% federal tax rate.

On a tax-equivalent basis, net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 was $258.6 million, an increase of $19.7 million, or 8.25%, compared with $238.9 million reported in the same qu arter in 2025. The increase in net interest income is primarily a result of downward pricing adjustments on deposits as market rates decreased, in addition to growth in average earning assets, partially offset by a decrease in asset yields. Average interest-earning assets increased $1.55 billion, or 6.23%, from $24.96 billion in the third quarter of 2025 to $26.51 billion for the third quarter of 2026. This growth in interest-earning assets resulted primarily from increased investment in our bond portfolio and organic loan growth, partially offset by a decrease in loans held for sale. The Company’s net interest margin during the third quarter of 2026 was 3.87%, up seven basis points from 3.80% re ported in the third quarter of 2025.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text:
Total noninterest income for the third quarte r of 2026 was $64.2 million, a decrease of $12.1 million, or 15.9%, from the $76.3 million reported in the third quarter of 2025. Income from mortgage banking activities was $29.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, a decrease of $11.4 million , or 28.1% , from $40.7 million in the third quarter of 2025. Total production in the third quarter of 2026 amounted to $994.4 million , c ompared with $1.09 billion in the same quarter of 2025, while gain on sale spread decreased to 2.09% in the third quarter of 2026, compared with 2.20% in the same quarter of 2025. The retail mortgage open pipeline finished the third quarter of 2026 at $439.9 million, co mpared with $609.3 million at June 30, 2026 and $787.2 million at the end of the third quarter of 2025.

Service charges on deposit accounts increased $141,000 , or 1.0%, to $14.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $13.9 million in the third quarter of 2025. The increase in service charges on deposit accounts was primarily attributable to growth in deposits. Income from equipment finance activit y increased $1.5 million, or 16.9%, to $10.4 million for the third quarter of 2026 , compared with $8.9 million during the third quarter of 2025. The increase in equipment finance activity was primarily related to increased non-insurance charges.

intro.text: We are a financial holding company whose business is conducted primarily through our wholly owned banking subsidiary, Ameris Bank (the “Bank”), which provides a full range of banking services to its retail and commercial customers who are primarily concentrated in select markets in Georgia, Alabama, Florida, North Carolina and South Carolina. The Company’s executive office is located at 3490 Piedmont Road N.E., Suite 1550, Atlanta, Georgia 30305, our telephone number is (404) 639-6500 and our internet address is www.amerisbank.com. We operate 163 full-service domestic banking offices. We do not operate in any foreign countries. At December 31, 2025, we had approximately $27.52 billion in total assets, $22.14 billion in total loans, $22.38 billion in total deposits and $4.08 billion of shareholders’ equity.

accounts.name: Cash and equivalents
